DECLARE @startDate AS Datetime = ?; 

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

WITH Scan AS (
    SELECT LabelNo, max(UploadDate) as UploadDate
    FROM [FastwayReports].[dbo].[TrackAndTraceData] WITH (INDEX ([LabelNo,UploadDate,CountryCode_N]))
    WHERE UploadDate > @startDate 
    AND CountryCode IN (1,6)
    GROUP BY LabelNo
)

SELECT 
       Label.[LabelNo]
      ,[CountryCode]
      ,[Electronic_CustomerType]
      ,[Electronic_CustomerID]
      ,[Electronic_Reference]
      ,[FastLabel_ConsignmentID]
      ,[FastLabel_DestinationRF]
      ,[Distribution_Date]
      ,[Distribution_FranchiseeCode]
      ,[KPI_PickupOK]
      ,[KPI_DeliveryOK]
      ,[KPI_LatePickup]
      ,[KPI_LateDelivery]
      ,[KPI_DelRF]
      ,[KPI_PicRF]
      ,[FMSCustomerID]
      ,[FMSRfID]
      ,[OES_CustomerId]
      ,[KPI_ExpectedDelivery]
      ,[KPI_ExceptionScan]
      ,[PrintedOn]
      ,[EbayClickCollect]
      ,[HasSubscriptions]
      ,Scan.[UploadDate]
FROM [FastwayReports].[dbo].[LabelMaster] AS Label
JOIN Scan ON Scan.LabelNo = Label.LabelNo ;

DECLARE @LastID INT = ?;

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

      ,[PickupAddr2]

WHERE [HistoryID] > @LastID
    AND CountryCode IN (1,6)

DECLARE @startDate datetime = ?

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

SELECT 
	d.LabelNumber, 
	d.CountryCode, 
	d.CreateDate, 
	d.LabelPrinted, 
	d.CustomerID, 
	d.ClientID, 
	d.ConsumedByCustomerUserID, 
	d.LblColour, 
	d.LblPrice, 
	d.LblPrice1,
	i.Reference, 
	i.Packaging, 
	i.Weight, 
	i.WeightCubic, 
	i.Length, 
	i.Width, 
	i.Height, 
	b.ManifestID, 
	b.Town, 
	b.PostCode, 
	b.destRF,
	i.itemID  
FROM [OnlineEnquiries_NEW].[dbo].[tblFastLabel_Book_Detail] d
JOIN [OnlineEnquiries_NEW].[dbo].[tblFastLabel_Consignment_Items] i on d.AppliedToItemID = i.ItemID
JOIN [OnlineEnquiries_NEW].[dbo].[tblFastLabel_Consignment] b on i.ConsignmentID = b.ConsignmentID
WHERE d.CreateDate >@startDate
    AND d.CountryCode IN (1,6)

DECLARE @startDate datetime = ?;

SELECT 
       ci.Label,  
       con.ConId,
       ci.ConItemId,
       ci.[LineNo],
       con.CountryId,
       con.CreatedOn,
       con.CustomerId,
       ci.FromRf, 
       ci.FromCf, 
       ci.ToRf, 
       ci.ToCf, 
       ci.FMSInvoiceNo,
       ci.FMSInvoiceDate,
       ci.BasePrice,
       cis.Reference,
       cis.Quantity,
       cis.ProductId,
       cis.WeightDead,
       cis.WeightCubic,
       cis.WeightPriced,
       cis.Width,
       cis.Length,
       cis.Height,
       con.FromStreetAddress,
       con.FromLocality,
       con.FromPostalCode,
       con.FromLat,
       con.FromLng,
       con.ToStreetAddress,
       con.ToLocality,
       con.ToPostalCode,
       con.ToLat,
       con.ToLng
FROM [FWFastlabel].[dbo].[fl_Con] con 
JOIN [FWFastlabel].[dbo].[fl_ConItemSum] cis on cis.ConId = con.ConId 
JOIN [FWFastlabel].[dbo].[fl_ConItem] ci on ci.ConId = cis.ConId and ci.[LineNo] = cis.[LineNo]
WHERE con.CreatedOn > @startDate
    AND con.CountryId IN (1,6)

DECLARE @startDate datetime = ?

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

SELECT 
    LabelNo, 
    CountryCode, 
    DateInserted, 
    ConDate, 
    RTRIM(SendAdd3) as PickupTown, 
    RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(15),SendAdd5)) as PickupPostcode, 
    RTRIM(RecAdd3) as DeliveryTown,
    RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(15),(Case when DeliveryPostCode is not null then DeliveryPostCode when LEN(RecAdd5) = 4 and RecAdd5!= '0000' then RecAdd5 else RecAdd4 end))) as DeliveryPostcode, 
    ManifestId, 
    ClientId, 
    CustomerID, 
    Quantity, 
    Weight, 
    Width, 
    Length, 
    Height, 
    CollectionRF, 
    DeliveryRF, 
    CollectionCountryCode, 
    DeliveryCountryCode, 
    RecordId,
    UniqueParcelIdentifier
FROM [Fastway].[dbo].[HDManifests]
WHERE DateInserted > @startDate
    AND CountryCode IN (1,6)

DECLARE @startDate datetime = ?

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

SELECT 
       cl.LabelNumber,
       cl.CountryId,
       cm.WebCustomerId,
       c.CustomerId,
       c.ReceiverContactName,
       c.ReceiverCompanyName,
       c.ReceiverAddress1,
       c.ReceiverAddress2,
       c.ReceiverSuburb,
       c.ReceiverCity,
       c.ReceiverPostcode,
       c.SpecialInstructions,
       c.ReceiverPhone,
       c.ReceiverEmail,
       cl.PrintedOn, 
       ci.Reference,
       c.DestinationRF,
       c.ManifestId,
       c.Price,
       c.InvoiceNo,
       c.ItemCount,
       cl.CreatedOn,
       ci.WeightCubic,
       ci.WeightDead,
       ci.Width,
       ci.Length,
       ci.Height,
       cl.Colour,
       cl.ConsignmentItemId
FROM FastLabelServer.dbo.Consignment c 
JOIN FastLabelServer.dbo.ConsignmentItem ci on c.CountryId = ci.CountryId and c.CustomerId = ci.CustomerId and c.Id = ci.ConsignmentId
JOIN FastLabelServer.dbo.ConsignmentLabel cl on ci.CountryId = cl.CountryId and ci.CustomerId = cl.CustomerId and ci.Id = cl.ConsignmentItemId
LEFT JOIN FastLabelServer.dbo.CustomerMap cm on c.CountryId = cm.CountryId and c.CustomerId = cm.CustomerId 
WHERE cl.CreatedOn > @startDate and cl.CountryId in (1,6)
